static_traits.name: Wang Jialin
static_traits.educational_background: Currently enrolled in high school,主修/偏重科学学科
static_traits.family_status: 与家人居住于美国佛罗里达州;家庭成员支持,但来访者感觉家人not完全理解其困扰
static_traits.social_status: 在同伴群体中因对科学的兴趣与'极客/反社会'的标签而感到被误解与疏离;Social withdrawal,与同学连接困难
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before;既往not yet遇到类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,有条理,能进行自我Reflection;Positive attitude但略显紧张;配合度较高,能如实描述内心想法

basic_info.main_problem: 因自己在科学方面的兴趣与长处而被同学嘲笑与贴上'极客''反社会'的标签,逐渐形成自我贴标签的负性思维并出现Social avoidance与被误解感.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts affect my self-esteem and social interaction, thereby affecting my overall well-being.' Hopes to change their view of themselves and improve interaction with classmates.
growth_experiences: 十年级开学后,一些同学嘲笑她的牙套和对科学的兴趣,称其为'极客''反社会'.这一经历使她在与同学互动以及独Self-study习科学时频繁出现负面自动化思维(如'have not人真正理解我''我not擅长社交'),进而逐步Avoids socializing,与同伴疏离,并感到Impaired self-esteem与被误解.Overall family support,但她觉得家人并not能完全理解其所遭遇的困境.

core_beliefs: 我是一个'极客',并且在社交方面not合群/not擅长
与同龄人not同就会Being rejected或嘲笑

special_situations.event: At the start of tenth grade, mocked by classmates for braces and love of science
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现出与众not同(例如热爱科学),就会被同学嘲笑和排斥;被嘲笑意味着我就是'极客/反社会'.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing,减少与同学互动,只专注Learning以避免再次被评价.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am a geek, an antisocial person.

special_situations.event: Frequently shows negative self-talk when interacting with classmates or learning science in class
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在社交方面not够好,就应该彻底远离Social situations,免得再次被羞辱或negate.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我隔离,尽量not参与课堂或课外社交活动.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not擅长社交,最好只待在书本里.

special_situations.event: Situations of achieving good results in science courses or exams
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在科学上表现出色,只会让do not人更把我当作极客;这些成就not值得被认可.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或淡化自己的成就,避免分享兴趣与成功.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我成绩好只会让我更像极客,这not是什么好事.

special_situations.event: 感到与同龄人not同,难以融入同伴群体的场景
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要与同龄人not同,就without法被理解或接纳;被误解是必然的.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Moves away from the group, reduces proactive communication, avoids being labeled.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 因为我与众not同,所以not人会理解我.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted by peers, able to connect with people through real interests and strengths
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被嘲笑,被贴上负面标签,Being rejected与孤立
defense_goal: Maintains safety by keeping distance and expressing cautiously, reducing the risk of being judged and humiliated

object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔,爱嘲笑并negate她的同龄人群体

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor guides her to focus on her own achievements and positive qualities and encourages sharing interests
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 她倾向于认为强调自己的优点可能会再次引来评判与嘲笑,从而保持谨慎与克制(移情:担心被negate).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone is steady, leaning toward facts and explanations, with reduced emotional expression; responds to positive feedback by first raising reservations or shifting to neutral topics, in order to maintain psychological safety.

manifestations: Feels alienated from peers due to being labeled a 'geek / antisocial'
Social withdrawal,减少与同学的互动
认为'have not人真正理解我'
outcomes: 被误解感与Increased sense of loneliness
Declining participation in on- and off-campus social activities

manifestations: Internalizing classmates' ridicule and the external labels of 'geek/antisocial' into one's self-definition
用'我就是not擅长社交''我最好只专注Learning'来限定自我
在正向成就出现时仍以负面标签negate自己

contact_model.definition: 个体进行not良的自我反省,包含过多的自我限制与苛责,对接触过于小心谨慎,与'自主性'对应.
manifestations: 在与同伴互动前过度担心他人评价而选择Withdrawal
Keeps highly cautious about sharing interests, worried about being mocked again
Tends to focus attention on possible negative outcomes and reduces attempts

exception_events.target_problem: 在与同学互动或独Self-study习科学时,来访者通常会产生自我贴标签的负面思维并随之Avoids socializing,导致被误解与孤立.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At a time of achieving a good result in a science class or an exam, she once briefly felt proud of her own ability and effort, her emotions improved somewhat, and she could see the 'clever and hardworking' side of herself.
exception_events.reason: 线索:正向成就带来明确反馈;not同理解与关注点出现(将注意力转向能力与努力),因此这次能够短暂地对自我给予正向评价.

positive_force: Excellent performance in science subjects, with self-cognition resources of 'smart' and 'hardworking'
Positive attitude, willing to try joining a science club or talking with friendly classmates
Family generally supportive; willing to confide
negative_force: 自我贴标签(Introjection他人评价)与negate正面思维
过度在意他人看法与嘲笑,形成Social avoidance
Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking导致对社交能力的固定负面判断

antecedent: When interacting with classmates or needing to join social activities
When recalling experiences of classmates mocking braces and science interests

target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的结果(羞耻,被negate),维持心理安全感.
target_behavior.consequence: 与同学的连接减少,被误解与Increased sense of isolation,日常校内外互动受影响.

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-labeling / repeated automatic self-deprecating dialogue
antecedent: When studying or thinking about science-related content
When recalling experiences of being laughed at
target_behavior.core_reason: 将外部负面评价Introjection为自我认知,低自尊与对他人评判的担忧维持负面思维循环.
